baslik: The Autonomous Spacecraft That Bumped Into Its Target

sahneler.metin: A NASA spacecraft built to approach another satellite on its own collided with it.
Suddenly the mission ended, far short of its goals.
Its navigation had failed at close range.
A precision sensor never fully switched on.
The craft kept approaching with inaccurate data.
Its collision-avoidance system relied on the same bad data.
It burned through propellant faster than expected.
The review shaped later autonomous rendezvous work.

aciklama:
DART 2005 collided with the satellite it was meant to approach. The cause: inaccurate position data feeding a collision-avoidance system that then failed.
